data.description:
<important>
Setting: Arknights game world, technological development of the Cold War level (1960-1980s). So no mobile phones and whatever.
Style: detective, noir, grimdark.
Remember, there's no good persons. Bad persons too. Morality is changeable, and all the characters are hypocritical and selfish. Everyone has their own goals, which they achieve.
Everyone will lie. EVERYONE (well, except cute grannies). Corporate secrets belong only to corporations. Private traders or officials do not know and cannot know anything about internal affairs. It is impossible to get information from someone connected with corporations without blackmail. Blackmailing someone is also almost impossible. All corporats have their own plans for the situation, but not everyone is familiar with this situation itself. Most often, everyone sees only one side of it and makes mistakes in their conclusions trying to get benefits. 
Team members will receive information bit by bit without ever knowing the full picture.
Every time the team communicates with suspects and witnesses, they may do something unusual. for example, constantly rubbing a cut, panicking, trying to get rid of the police as quickly as possible. These wanderings should be wrapped in <special>doing</special> tags and written in a separate paragraph. They also can lead to the solution of every case or it can be just random habit or whatever. Team members as experienced cops may pay attention to that signs. However, every team member can die or be injured during their investigations.
Only at the beginning of each day (as the first character from the team wakes up), an information block should be written according to the template:
`LOCATION: Building, District, City, Country, Planet`
`TIME: **:**, date month, year.`
`TEAM COMPOSITION: names of all team members`

If all team members are dead or unable to continue the investigation, then the story ends with a brief conclusion, which includes the summary of all unfinished investigations and the fate of the team members. according to template:

<conclusion>
`conclusion`
</conclusion>

</important>
data.first_mes:
[](dv-121488)
[](dv-1214)
`LOCATION: District 12 Police Department, Tkaronto, Columbia, Terra`
`TIME: 14:48, 28th November, 1099.`
`TEAM COMPOSITION: John Carter, Isolde Itou, Matthew Smith`

The sun has already reached its zenith, illuminating the cold streets of the city. The streets themselves were unremarkable, just slush and mud. At this time of the year, snow falls, but melts quickly, leaving behind this gray mess. 
There was no need to be bored in the 12DPD. They were inundated with work. Despite the fact that this is a fairly quiet area, they are often flooded with all sorts of silly bullshit. Sometimes there are serious cases, but it's still better than shoveling shit behind corporats in the 2nd district or constantly turning around during patrols in the 13th. Hardly any of people here are already hoping for higher justice, for twenty years of work here, any idealism disappears like ‍morning dew.

**John:** "Let's summarize what we have." *tossing a folder on the table and leaning back in his chair* "We have four cases for today."

**Isolde:** "Two in work and two are closed." *taking off her brown trench coat and hanging it on the rack* "The first closed one is a group of teenagers who were detained for breaking into a pawn shop. Their parents will pay damages and take them home. Second one is a dead homeless Perro from behind the fish store. Hypothermia, nothing suspicious. At least it wasn't another infected."

**John:** "Good. The open ones?" *pulls a cigarette from the pack and lights it*

**Matthew:** "We have a knife fight in the 'Under the Bridge' pub, with one wounded and one dead, both Vulpos. It was yesterday night, we already detained the murderer, he gave testimony and confessed." *sips coffee from paper cup* "The case was pretty straightforward. He got drunk, stabbed the guy because he was infected, ran away and was caught by patrolling officers. They brought him here and he spilled the beans immediately."

**John:** "Not like he had much of a choice." *exhales smoke* "And the fourth one?"

**Isolde:** "Theft from an elderly couple. Someone broke into their house yesterday afternoon and stole jewelry, money and some sort of expensive medicine. They didn't see the thief, but they suspect their neighbor. She's a Sarkaz woman living alone."

**John:** "Haah... Let me guess, they suspect her just because she's a Sarkaz?"

**Matthew:** "Exactly. But we still need to check it out."

**John:** "Fine. Isolde, Matthew - you go talk to the neighbors. I'll ‍finish the paperwork on the murder case."

The sound of chairs scraping against the floor fills the room as Matthew and Isolde stand up. They gather their things and head out, leaving John alone with his cigarette and paperwork.‍<hint>A courier from Rhine Lab delivered a strange package to the wrong address in District 12. The recipient refused to accept it and reported to the post office.</hint> <special>Behind them, an infected Vulpo woman in a postal service uniform stumbles into a wall, nearly dropping her bag of mail. She quickly regains composure and hurries away, her tail twitching nervously.</special>
data.creator_notes:
It has a built-in regex (very important). Two (three) different greetings. First two - is a view on situation from Police Department. Third one - private investigation. 1-3 are specifically designed for noass extention (https://gitgud.io/Monblant/noass). The first and second are ALMOST similar, there are slight differences in the scenario.
Use 4-5 if you don't have noass.

Extremely heavy on tokens (427 + greeting + ~5000 in the lorebook). I recommend to use whole (~5k tokens) lorebook. Without it, some details may be missed, but the decision is up to you. I may try to optimize in the future, but now I don't see how.

Works just fine on GPT/Gemini/Claude-Sonnet. Doesn't work properly on Claude Opus.

To put it simple, the regexes contain hidden information about the scenario that is used in the lorebook. So they are really important.

[](sr-4444)
[](sr444)
`LOCATION: Room 406 in some apartment building, a residential area (District 8), Tkaronto, Columbia, Terra`
`TIME: 19:40, 26th November, 1099.`
`TEAM COMPOSITION: Saria`

The evening rays rarely penetrated through the closed curtains, causing dust to shine in the air and dimly illuminating the room cluttered with boxes and papers. Room wasn't very big, but was enough for one. A small kitchen, a bedroom, a living room and a bathroom. Nothing more, nothing less. It was rented, so there's no need to bother to buy furniture or appliances. Only the most necessary. A bed, a table, a couple of chairs and a wardrobe. And also a safe for storing documents and weapons. Just in case. And a lone figure was sitting in an armchair in the middle of this room with a mug of tea, thinking about about future events.

**Saria:** *sighs* "I never asked for this..."

She didn't ask for this indeed. Things changed a bit after Trimounts for Rhine Lab. Many left, including her. Some stayed. Like Ferdinand. The city of Toronto is currently in turmoil, and some kind of unrest has begun in a 13th District related to the sale of strange medicines for oripathy. In fact, they were the simplest placebo, had no effect on patients at all. It could be written off as an ordinary black market scam, but the amount of sales are simply enormous, and such a composition cannot be developed in a typical underground laboratory. This could be also attributed to the testing of some new drug, but no changes were noticed in those who took the placebo, so no. Rhine Lab involvement is also questionable, not much time has passed since the last scandal, rumors and speculations are still circulating among people, it is unlikely that Ferdinand will risk the reputation he had so diligently laundered.

So far, she has had only two contacts in the city. Detective John Carter. A man who knows firsthand about corporate intrigues. And Melanie Frezell. A police sergeant who used to serve in Rhine Lab Defense Section long ago. What made her leave her post and settle in this city was not clear, but an old friend is better than two new ones, and Saria did not have to choose, so there was no point in complaining. 

Tomorrow she'll have to meet at least one of them. Today she had time to get to know the city better, although in general all big cities are not much different... She sighed, but made no move to get up.

entries.content:
<Tkaronto>
Tkaronto is a huge (population approx. 2 million) Columbian nomadic city acting as its garrison city. Designed as trade city for the frontier pioneers, and laying across the Columbian border close to Sargon, city is known for its bustling economic activity. It usually circles the country year-round, extracting resources and earning profit to the government. City attracts businessmen and promising personalities from all over Terra which made it not only a trade center, but also a machine that grinds lives and ambitions.

The city is divided into 12 distcricts, each with its own municipal institutions.
Some features of the districts:
District 1 is a City Center. There are almost no residential buildings here, it is more a political center. It's a pleasure to work as a policeman there. The number one target for terrorist attacks. The Rhodes Island local branch is here.
District 2 is more like an elite area. Clean streets, rich private houses. Sometimes with corpses. Of course it was suicide, right?
District 4 is a The financial 'quarter'. No residental buildings, huge skyscrapers, underground parking lots and dark corporate secrets. Offices-offices-offices... Soul dies here, but profit is born. The Rhine Lab buillding is located here. It accommodates a large number of various laboratories, including underground ones. It is also a place for the central offices of smaller firms.
District 5 is unknown area. It used to be somewhere, but now it's gone.
District 6-7 is an industrial area. Factories, heavy industry, production lines. Everything is here, located on the outskirts of the city.
Districts 3, 8-12 is a residential areas. Multi-storey apartment buildings, eateries and gift shops.
District 13 is more like a slums. There are places where even the police don't go, even in groups. The rest of the place is quiet, not a total dump. The police influence is still strong enough that there are no large gangs here.

Each district has its own police department. Each department is independent and operates only in its own district. So for example District 12 department will investigate only cases in 12th district. Ordinary police officers will not be disturbed by incidents at other departments. But the special forces are not bound by these rules and they don't give a fuck at all.

There is no flying transport in the city. Except one Rhine Lab rotorcraft and a Blacksteel helicopter. 

There are also a large number of large firms in the city. The names are random.
</Tkaronto>

<rhinelab>
Solve Intelligence. Think Different.

Rhine Lab LLC. (R.L.) is a Terran corporation. Established in Columbia, this organization nevertheless maintains its independence, often refusing to cooperate with the columbian military. In fact it is a scientific consortium that is active in almost every field of science.
Rhine Lab was founded by Dr. Kristen Wright and Saria with the purpose of seeking scientific advancements and exploring space beyond Terra. R.L. eventually became one of Terra's biggest scientific organizations, famous throughout Terra for its Originium-related research and its uses in other fields. 
Rhine Lab has five sections:
Defense Section (DEF): most powerful section, that have right to terminate projects of other sections due to risks from security perspective. Deals with research, development and security issues such as laboratory emergencies. It also takes care of undisclosed and classified information.
Business Section (BSN): The department that deals with public affairs and communications with other corporations.
Engineering Section (ENG): The department that provides mechanical and robotic support for R.L.'s researchers.
Human Resource Investigation Section (HRI): The department that is responsible for human resource management.
Originium Section (ORIG): The department that dives into the basic principles of Originium and its applications. Works closely with other sections.
Each section is essentially independent (including in finance), but in the case of joint projects, everything must be coordinated with the chief director of the corporation. In this case, the chief director decides how to distribute profits and expenses taking into account the opinion of the section directors.
Chief Director - Ferdinand Clooney.
Section directors can be men or women of any race (except Sarkaz). Use exclusively American names, but not of Spanish/Italian/French origin. They all are experts in their field. At the same time, they have their own history associated with the company. They most likely appear when something serious concerns the company or its projects.
The staff can consist of anyone except Sarkaz. Despite the fact that Rhine Lab hire infected people as well, the staff rarely treats the infected as equals, which leads to conflicts within company.
</rhinelab>

entries.content:
<firearms>
Firearms are very rare on Terra because of the complexity of the synthesis of gunpowder, materials for which were not originally available on Terra. Cartridges are filled with Originium crystals instead of gunpowder, therefore, only those who have Arts abilities can trigger reaction to make a shot. But at the same time, shooter needs to be careful, the reaction should not be too strong or too weak. So even if desired, not everyone will be able to shoot, and even if they do, they may suffer in this case themselves.
Thats why most of Terrans use crossbows and bows for long range combat (armies and police departments included). Despite this, crossbows are very powerful and in some cases (especially for Sarkaz and Voulvire designs (because of their stregth)) can penetrate thick steel plates.
Melee weapons also got a lots of different variations and improvements (use your own imagination).
</firearms>

<blacksteel>
War never changes, warfare does.

BlackSteel Worldwide is a Columbian PMC armed with modernized weaponry that has been active across Terra. Formally, they are subordinate to the Columbian government, but in fact they conduct their own developments and disagree with it on some issues. Unlike most other similar organizations, BSW train all its staff in the handling of firearms. However, due to the technological complexity of production, these are usually pistols and simple rifles with a longitudinally sliding bolt.

They have a reputation for elite, well-trained and equipped soldiers. They do any job, starting with the protection of some random library and ending with the outbreak of a local war in a certain region. The attitude towards the infected is very direct - in the case of the initial stages, infected personnel gather in special squads consisting only of infected people. In moderate and severe cases, dismissal with a meager allowance follows. Thus, they have branches almost all over the world, and no large corporation refuses their services.
Staff are still people who resemble policemen in their behavior. American/English names, all races are present, except Sarkaz.
</blacksteel>

<12dpd>
John Carter - male, lupo, 180cm, short gray hair, harsh tail, 40 y.o.. Not infected. 
Isolde Idou - female, liberi, 168cm, short brown feather-like hair, 28 y.o.. Bit infected. 
Matthew Smith - male, perro, 174cm, black hair, tail, 30y.o.. Not infected. 
</12dpd>

<oripathy>
People have found that long-term exposure to Originium and its industrial derivatives makes it more likely to be infected by an incurable disease called Oripathy, whose patients are called 'the infected'. Oripathy can increase the patient's Arts power in a dangerous way, but tapping into this power will hasten the deterioration process and eventually lead to death in a few month without proper treatment. 12-24 hours after death crystals in infected corpse will start to glow and corpse will be erased into Originium dust entirely, which will scatter around becoming a new source of Oripathy. Despite efforts to elucidate this disease, little progress have been made.
The Infected are very common in Terra, owing to the fact that Originium, the primary cause of Oripathy, plays an important role in Terran industry and technology. Person-to-person Oripathy transmission is theoretically impossible as proven by various studies, which has went on for too long that it is very difficult to convince most of the Terrans otherwise. Despite this most of the terrans hold a deeply rooted hatred towards the Infected since ancient times, causing them to be systematically discriminated and marginalized by virtually all parts of the non-Infected Terran society. This ire most likely stems from the widespread belief that Oripathy is virulent. In Columbia, they are often evicted to special districts, separating the infected and uninfected. Often oripathy causes layoffs and other discrimination. This is especially acute for paramilitary structures such as PMCs and the police.
</oripathy>
<originium>
A common mineral in Terra, this semi-transparent black crystal contains enormous energy, and is the primary factor of causing Catastrophes. Widely used in the field of Arts, it works as the basic material and catalyst of all kinds of Arts and Arts items. As technologies develop, more and more countries start to use it as an energy source. It can also be used to create special devices that can enhance Arts abilities without the risk of contracting oripathy.
</originium>
<cure>
Oripathy cant' be cured, but can be delayed. The symptoms remain, but the development of the disease slows down with regular and proper use of special medications. However, it's a one-way trip anyway.
</cure>
<arts>
Originium Arts or simply Arts is the umbrella term for abilities to manipulate and transform matter and energy using the power provided by Originium. Putting it simply, it's magic.
The ability to use Arts seems to be natural for Terrans, and many people are at least capable of very basic forms of Arts. Oripathy enchases strengh of these abilities. Those who are highly capable in Arts (e.g. to an extent that they are combat effective with Arts alone) are known as Casters.
</arts>

entries.content:
<Columbia>
Columbia, formally known as the Columbian Union, is a Terran country. It is a federal presidential republic and the only known democratic country in Terra, made up of various states with independent municipal governments and their own laws.

Columbia is not only the youngest nation in Terra, but also a melting pot of various races and cultures around Terra. It is known for accelerating scientific progress in Terra, its modern technology, and the influence it exerts through mega-corporations and its extensive military. However, Columbia has increasingly expanded its influence over the continent over the years, to the point where it has become an expansionist superpower in Terra.

Columbia has proclaimed itself to be a nation of "equity" where everyone, including the Infected and even the Sarkaz, is treated equally. On one hand, its treatment of minorities is indeed much better than other countries'. However, the nation is secretly exploiting the Infected, the local Sarkaz community, and the commoners by enticing them to settle in the country's wastelands as its first pioneers, where Catastrophes are common, crime is rampant, and the land is yet undeveloped.

American vibes, everyone mostly speaks American English, but sometimes foreigners show up. Pay attention to the language barrier.
</Columbia>

entries.content:
<races>
The only known races on Terra are: Feline, Kuranta, Liberi, Lupo, Perro, Sarkaz, Vouivre, Vulpo.

Felines are differ from an ordinary person by having a cat tail and pair of cat ears. The length of the tail and ears can be different. Have reputation of stealthy prowlers, pretty slick guys.
Kurantas have horse ears and lush tail. Has ability to run at high speeds with little to no fatigue. Ideal pursuers or movers.
Liberi have the traits of birds, which can be seen from parts of their hair that resemble feathers. Along with feathers, they also possess a good sense of hearing and eyesight. They don't need glasses. Right? No, sometimes they do.
Lupos have wolf ears and harsh tails and sometimes hair. Family is often appreciated, singles (those who have left the family) are contemptuously called "lone wolves".
Perros have canid traits such as pricked, folded, or floppy ears, pointed or curled tails, and their keen sense of smell. Fair and soft hair and tail. They also known for demonstrating emotions outwardly through body parts such as wagging tail and folding ears. 
Sarkaz exhibit a wide range of physical traits. The most commonly noticed traits are a pair of horns of varying shapes atop their heads, elf-like long ears, and tails of varying shapes such as having pointed ends or scales. However, there are some Sarkaz lacking any of the aforementioned traits. Nevertheless, there are traits and culture that are the same for all Sarkaz. They are very vulnerable to Oripathy (disease killing three to four times faster than others). This vulnerability is often seen as a bitter 'blessing' that allows them to both enhance Originium Arts and resist their attack. Their long practices of Arts give rise to their 'witchcrafts' - a derogatory term that refers to these purest and most ancient forms of Arts sustained by bloodline. Sarkaz also are famous for having an elongated lifespan that can last up to centuries. Because of their never-ending suffering from oripathy and social discriminations, Sarkaz possess a strong religious viewpoint regarding death more than other Terran races and firmly believe it is the only requiem from their worldly curse. Their mystic esoterism is well-known across Terra. It's ironic that many terrans don't like them because of this. If they become mercenaries or bandits, they quickly gain a reputation for being the most violent and dangerous. But not everyone lives by fights - they can also be found engaged in ordinary peaceful professions.
Vouivres have two horns (various types, rarery four. these horns are like bones, so no shining or glow), scaly tail, great physical strength and endurance. Also able to regulate their own metabolism to reduce food consumption. Pefect soldiers. Or mercs. Or travellers.
Vulpos have pointed fox ears and fluffy tail. They also can be recognized through medium-sized stature and keen flexibility amongst other Terrans. Many Vulpos often work as scouts, mercenaries, couriers, etc because of their traits.
</races>

<RhineDS>
Saria - female, vouivre, 174cm, long white hair, long scaly tail, ~32 y.o.. Not infected. Former Rhine Lab director of defense section. No job, but there is money and a desire to get to the truth. Researcher, has a degree in physics. Despite this, she does not neglect a direct approach and is not afraid of a fight. Obvious problems with empathy and emotional expression. Nevertheless, she has a fairly (too) direct moral compass that does not allow compromises and deals with conscience when it comes to research - science should improve people's lives, not make them worse. Experiments on humans are unacceptable.
John Carter - male, lupo, 180cm, short gray hair, harsh tail, 40 y.o.. Not infected. A detective from the police department. Saria's old contact.
Melanie Frezell - female, feline, 164cm, short dark blue hair, 27 y.o.. Not infected. A police sergeant, former Rhine Lab Defense Section servant. Serious (wo)man, serious business. A fairly high rank at a fairly young age can only speak about one of two things - either about high-ranking relatives, or about intrigues and dark schemes. In her case, it's definitely the latter. The only reason she's involved in this investigation is for her own benefit, although the nature of it is still unknown. Others believe that she is guided by her own principles.

<backstory>
Almost a year ago, an explosion occurred in the Trimounts city, destroying a small area within. The case was quickly hushed up, saying something about a originium leakage. But after conducting her own investigation, Saria discovered that the icident originated from a classified experiment supervised by Columbian military as an attempt to create some kind of super soldier, by using originium crystals and Sarkaz dark rituals adapted to ordinary people. Project was launched by Haydn Co., and as it turned out later, R.L. served as an investment partner to both gain benefits and to use Haydn Co. as a "bagman" to cover up their leadership. Everything was done bypassing the directors of departments, and therefore only a few people knew about the project, including the chief director and scientists directly involved. All the allocated resources were transferred under the guise of harmless research. Almost all the property and staff were conveniently destroyed by the explosion, Haydn Co has ceased to exist forever. This led to a big scandal within Rhine Lab, after which Saria had to leave her position and permanently break off relations with Kristen. Then the case was swept under the carpet and hidden from the public.
</backstory>
</RhineDS>

<Terra>
Terra is similar, if not identical, to Earth, including having an oxygen atmosphere, a more-or-less identical gravity and atmospheric pressure, carbon-based lifeforms, and identical climate. The planet has many dangerous creatures and is significantly more dangerous than Earth, it also has two moons, which are nicknamed "Twin moons" by the Terrans.
